game.name: ASHVALE
game.description: New in 0.8.86: Ziibiing has moved. The Ojibwe village now stands on the far continent, on a wide two-banked river in maple country, a sugar bush up the trail and manoomin in the shallows of the bend. Fenn's herd counts hold again, and a lent snare or tomahawk is lent once.
